entities.summary: Kakheti, a notable figure in the history of Georgia, associated with Russian Annexation and Imperial Georgia (1783–1810). Preceded by Treaty of Georgievsk places eastern Georgia under Russian protection. Their legacy influenced Aga Mohammad Khan of Persia sacks Tbilisi and Russia abolishes the Georgian monarchy and directly annexes Kartli-Kakheti.
